info.title: RoomQC control directory v3
info.description: Foundation implementation plus explicitly marked planned APIs. Inventory of routes is not evidence of runtime availability.

x-retry.HTTP409: Read current version; do not generate a replacement command silently.
x-retry.HTTP503: Preserve intent and command ID; show unavailable.

get.description: DB, version history, registry and runtime privilege checks. No remote cluster-health requirement.
DB, version history, registry and runtime privilege checks. No remote cluster-health requirement.

post.description: Global signup flag plus admission in v3; Origin must match public origin.

Requires a live verified eligible owner via registration_actor at the assigned cluster. Persist an immutable setup dispatch and receipt-reconcile job atomically before remote provisioning. Duplicate pending POST returns 202 without another remote mutation; payload changes conflict. Gateway sends exact hashed JSON and session ID to the fenced RPC. Activate and settle atomically from a matching result. Legacy provisioning without closure proof fails closed. New dispatch requires the explicit setup-dispatch cutover flag; receipt recovery remains available when new dispatch is disabled. Tokens and business fields are never persisted in the job or journal.

202.description: An existing dispatch is pending; no new remote mutation was sent. Poll private setup-status. This is not proof of activation.

get.description: Read-only and no-store. Requires the live verified registration owner and session at the assigned cluster, matching email hash and durable owner ID. Primary directory/job snapshots surround the immutable receipt read; mapping changes or session revocation fail closed. Missing receipt without a durable recovery decision is unknown, never permission to provision again. No mutation, activation or job creation on GET.
Whitelisted filters, stable server cursor and bounded page. Cluster outage remains visible as unavailable.
Whitelisted filters, stable server cursor and bounded page. Cluster outage remains visible as unavailable.
Strict state/severity filters and stable openedAt/id cursor. Open excludes acknowledged; acknowledged excludes resolved. No filter returns all episodes.

Directory metadata only, not a live object-store or restore verification. Rows, filter-wide total and asOf share one PostgreSQL statement snapshot. Failed reads are errors, never an empty successful page. Stable createdAt/id cursor binds all filters; no signed URLs or object paths.
Whitelisted filters, stable server cursor and bounded page. Cluster outage remains visible as unavailable.

Primary single-statement snapshot across all rows. Includes observed global signup configuration and free workspace slots on admission-open clusters; no guarantee for a later signup or for an email-affinity target. No mutation or secret configuration is exposed.

post.description: Select an approved inventory endpoint and server credential reference. Pending validation, admission closed. No arbitrary probe URL.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Persist this UUID through retries and reload. Same actor+operation+key with different payload returns 409.

post.description: Version check, mutation, append-only event and command receipt commit atomically. Validation probes run outside DB locks using only a dedicated manifest canary credential and an installer-owned approved release catalog. The current target, approval and credential fingerprints plus proof age are rechecked inside the command transaction before saving. Missing approval never falls back to service_role. Validation closes admission and proves release compatibility only, not five-service health; reopening requires all admission gates.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Persist this UUID through retries and reload. Same actor+operation+key with different payload returns 409.

get.description: Read a durable successful receipt from the primary directory using the original client-generated key. Every read rechecks live support authority and scopes actor, authority cluster, target cluster, operation and exact case-sensitive key. This is a historical mutation snapshot, not current health or permission to reopen admission; refresh cluster detail before a new command. It performs no mutation, retry or audit write. Keep replay POST with the same key and payload for compatibility. This endpoint does not recover workspace recheck jobs.

parameters.name: operation
parameters.description: Exactly one operation; duplicate and undeclared query parameters are rejected.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Persist before the original POST. Reuse the exact UUID string including casing; never generate a new key merely because an outcome is unknown.

200.description: Durable successful receipt with a fresh requestId and a closed public projection of its original snapshot. No secrets or internal request fields.

404.description: COMMAND_RESULT_UNKNOWN: no visible committed receipt for this exact identity. The original transaction may still be in progress; this is not proof of failure. Keep the original key, check again with bounded backoff, or replay the identical POST. Wrong actor/authority/target/operation/key has the same missing outcome.

409.description: COMMAND_RESULT_UNAVAILABLE: started, failed or inconsistent receipt. Never treat this as success or automatically recreate the command with a new key.

get.description: Redacted workspace/history/receipt; never exposes email_hash or bearer tokens.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of timeline events per page.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque timeline cursor bound to this workspace.

get.description: Read-only summary using a dedicated short-lived service credential at the bound cluster. No owner impersonation, service-role fallback or writes. Directory target/version is checked again after remote read. Unbound/missing/credential/offline states never become zero counts. Staff includes all nondeleted assigned accounts, including owner, in every status; rooms are actual room rows. Requires roomqc_summary exposed and a separately provisioned private credential file; no production deployment acceptance implied.

post.description: Actor-scoped durable reconciliation command. Persist key and exact payload before POST. Replay is serialized before rejecting stale snapshots. Never provisions a tenant, resets a trial or impersonates its owner. 202 means the existing/new bounded recovery job is pending; 200 is a recorded decision, not necessarily an active workspace. Live authority checks are bounded observations, not a distributed transaction with Auth revocation.

200.description: Recorded reconciliation decision. Inspect outcome and refresh current workspace.

202.description: Recorded command with queued, reused or running background job; setup is not complete.

post.description: Acknowledge never resolves measurements or reopens admission.

post.description: Existing canonical live-admin authority; receipt verification and redacted bounded history.

Reconcile only an existing matching legacy business receipt; never provision another tenant/trial. Durable intent precedes canonical Auth acceptance. Effect, audit, consumption and result commit together. Same-key replay returns the original action after a current live-authority check. The query is a locator, excluded from the semantic hash; workspace UUID, routingVersion and trimmed reason bind the command. Unknown transport outcomes retain the original key/body.

200.description: Filtered historical result of the original command. It does not certify current workspace readiness.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Persist the original UUID and exact body before dispatch. Scope is actor + authority cluster + support/reconcile + workspace + key. Changed semantic body returns 409; requestId is trace only.

get.description: Read the immutable acknowledgement receipt using the original key, scoped to the live canonical actor, authority, target and operation. Unknown remains unknown; it is not permission to issue a new key.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Persist this UUID through retries and reload. Same actor+operation+key with different payload returns 409.

get.description: Primary read-only no-store lookup of the original key. Scope is actor + authority cluster + workspace + operation + key. No query parameters. 404 is unknown, not proof of rollback: retain intent and retry only the same POST key and payload. Historical receipt does not describe current workspace status.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Persist this UUID through retries and reload. Same actor+operation+key with different payload returns 409.

get.description: Read-only no-store lookup of the original command. Exactly one workspaceId query parameter and the original Idempotency-Key are required. Actor and authority are taken from the canonical live session, never query input. Rechecks authority after the database read. 404 means no successful result is visible yet; it is unknown, never proof of rollback or permission to use a new key.

parameters.description: Persist the original UUID and exact body before dispatch. Scope is actor + authority cluster + support/reconcile + workspace + key. Changed semantic body returns 409; requestId is trace only.

200.description: Filtered historical result of the original command. It does not certify current workspace readiness.

404.description: SUPPORT_RESULT_NOT_FOUND: retain original intent; unknown, not proof of no effect.

get.description: Read registered hosts and their linked cluster; legacy clusters remain unassigned. Explicit public projection; no SSH or provider credentials.
Read server-approved inventory references excluding occupied cluster IDs/hosts. Fixed epoch and descending ID cursor, bound to public inventory revision. Does not connect or install a VPS.

Read durable deployment progress and original receipts, with immutable reconciliation results separately. This is historical evidence, not a fresh health check. No SSH addresses, private paths or credentials.
get.summary: Read operator deployment progress and durable receipts

get.description: Authenticated primary-directory read. No SSH addresses, private paths, keys or lease tokens. Strict filter-bound cursor pagination.
Authenticated primary-directory read. No SSH addresses, private paths, keys or lease tokens. Strict filter-bound cursor pagination.

Error.description: Stable error; no SQL detail, token, raw provider payload or customer email.

RuntimeResources.description: Safe resource configuration cached at startup. A matching fingerprint is not readiness, DB identity, running replica or capacity proof. Null for local development without a shared budget.

Provision.x-behavior: Only listed business fields forwarded; owner/email/role/subscription/IDs are server supplied.

schemaVersion.description: Legacy one-disk metrics or v2 independently measured required data mounts.

measurementScope.description: Null for legacy snapshots. Docker Desktop VM is not Linux VPS capacity evidence.

dataDisks.description: Null for v1; safe mount IDs and values only, never filesystem paths or device names. Stale values remain visible but are not healthy.

retryAfter.description: Seconds before another read when nextAction is wait; null for other actions.

backupId.description: Public display identifier only; null when stored value is a URL/path or otherwise not safe for display.

total.description: All rows matching filters, before cursor. Not the number of objects whose live availability has been verified.

SupportWorkspaceSnapshot.description: Legacy snake_case redacted support snapshot stored with the successful command. Separate from the camelCase admin Workspace DTO.

SupportReconcileResult.description: commandId equals actionId and remains unchanged across replay/recovery; requestId traces this HTTP request only.

x-null-and-failure-policy: Missing values are null, never zero; stale metrics stay visible and disable commands as appropriate. API totals use server aggregates. Admin fields never include credential values, raw email hashes or signed backup URLs.
